name: Vitamin B6
summary: PMS symptom support; homocysteine metabolism; safety screen: neuropathy risk with high-dose chronic use.
description: Vitamin B6 evidence is mixed and context-specific rather than high-confidence: PMS signals coexist with substantial risk-of-bias and comparator limitations, while high supplemental exposure carries a source-backed peripheral-neuropathy risk.
safetyNotes: Avoid high or prolonged supplemental exposure without appropriate clinical context; peripheral neuropathy is the key dose- and duration-related safety limiter.
evidenceLevel: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
